questions.stem: She has worked in this hospital ____ five years.

options.distractor: five years 是一段长度，要用 for
in 表示“在……之后”，与完成时矛盾

questions.explanation: five years 是时间段，用 for。

questions.stem: They have lived in this city ____ they were children.

options.distractor: 后面是一个起点时间（从童年起）
when 不用于完成时的时间起点
in 不与完成时连用表示起点

questions.explanation: “从他们还是孩子的时候起”是时间点（从句形式），用 since。

questions.stem: — How long ____ you ____ (study) English? — For three years.

options.distractor: 答语 For three years 说明要用完成时
问的是到目前为止学了多久

questions.explanation: How long 问持续多久，用现在完成时 have studied。

questions.stem: We haven't seen each other ____ last summer.

options.distractor: last summer 是起点，要用 since
in last summer 不是正确搭配
during 表示“在……期间”，不是起点

questions.explanation: last summer 是时间点，用 since。

options.text: I have known him for ten years.
She has been here since Monday.
He has waited for two hours ago.

questions.explanation: for 后面不能接 ago，应改为 for two hours 或 since two hours ago。

questions.stem: My brother ____ (be) in the army since he finished school.

options.distractor: since 引导的从句说明状态持续到现在
这里没有“过去的过去”的参照点

questions.explanation: since 从句 + 到现在为止的状态，主句用 has been。
